entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE (HIKESHI). In patient-derived iPSC extracts HIKESHI protein is barely detectable in homozygous cells and about a quarter to a third of control in heterozygous relatives, while HSP70, HSP90, GRP78 and HSP40 do not change.
entries.snippet: Immunoblotting for HIKESHI and HSPs (Fig. 1A) demonstrated a lack of detectable HIKESHI protein in HIKHOM extracts from iPSCs

entries.proposition: The authors attribute the loss to degradation. The transcript being unchanged is taken from a previous report ('It was previously reported that the relative expression level of HIKESHI mRNA is unchanged').
